[EN] Hagand's attempt to activate the Relativity Stone failed, leading him to suggest that disabling the Storm Barrier would be the key to opening the teleportal to Velika.
[ES] El intento de Hagand por activar la Relativity Stone falló, lo que lo llevó a sugerir que desactivar la Storm Barrier sería la clave para abrir el teleportal hacia Velika.

[EN] Paesyn said he needed to talk to you—said it was really important. He was going to come looking for you himself, but I convinced him to let me come with him.

He's waiting in the pasture at the top of this ladder."I'll go talk to him."
[ES] Paesyn dijo que necesitaba hablar contigo, dijo que era muy importante. Iba a venir a buscarte él mismo, pero lo convencí de que me dejara venir con él.

Está esperando en el pasto en la parte alta de esta escalera."I'll go talk to him."

[EN] ! We found you!

Listen, I need your help! I saw Zolyn looking at a picture of her sister earlier, and they were holding springlike flowers. And a little while ago, I saw a baraka with some of those very same flowers!

I want to give them to Zolyn, as an apology for whatever I did wrong with that relaxation potion I gave her. The baraka said they grow around here somewhere, but I can't find any! Help me!"Are you SURE that's what you want to do?"
[ES] ¡! ¡Te encontramos!

¡Escucha, necesito tu ayuda! Vi a Zolyn mirando una foto de su hermana hace un rato, y sostenían flores primaverales. Y hace poco, ¡vi a un baraka con algunas de esas mismas flores!

Quiero dárselas a Zolyn como disculpa por lo que hice mal con esa poción de relajación que le di. ¡El baraka dijo que crecen por aquí en alguna parte, pero no encuentro ninguna! ¡Ayúdame!"Are you SURE that's what you want to do?"

[EN] Of course! Why not? They'll remind her of her sister—and even if that doesn't make her feel good, it will make her that much more determined to find her again! It's a sure thing!

Did you see any, down in the quarry?"No...but I might know someone who knows where to find them."
[ES] ¡Por supuesto! ¿Por qué no? Le recordarán a su hermana, e incluso si eso no la hace sentir bien, ¡hará que esté mucho más decidida a encontrarla de nuevo! ¡Es seguro!

¿Viste alguna abajo en la cantera?"No...but I might know someone who knows where to find them."

[EN] Oh, thank you, !

And I promise: Whether this works or not, that's the end of it! I won't try to cheer Zolyn up any more!

...But it'll work. I know it will!"Sure, Paesyn. I'll let you know if I find them."
[ES] ¡Oh, gracias, !

Y te lo prometo: funcione o no, ¡se acabó! ¡No intentaré animar más a Zolyn!

...Pero funcionará. ¡Sé que lo hará!"Sure, Paesyn. I'll let you know if I find them."

[EN] You're the best, !

While you talk to your contact, I'll keep looking for the flowers around here. Be careful, now!"You too."
[ES] ¡Eres el mejor, !

Mientras hablas con tu contacto, seguiré buscando las flores por aquí. ¡Ten cuidado!"You too."

[EN] You!

Stone delivered! Job done!

Business done! Going now!"Wait...I need something else."
[ES] ¡Tú!

¡Piedra entregada! ¡Trabajo hecho!

¡Negocio terminado! ¡Me voy ahora!"Wait...I need something else."

[EN] You pay more then!

What need?"Springlike flower. Enough for a bouquet."
[ES] ¡Entonces pagas más!

¿Qué necesitas?"Springlike flower. Enough for a bouquet."

[EN] Flower?

Like, flower from dirt?

Like, flower baraka grow?

Baraka like that one there, that one there, Hagand there...this trick, right?

"Hagand's here? Never mind—I'll ask him."
[ES] ¿Flor?

¿Como, flor de la tierra?

¿Como, flor que crece el baraka?

Baraka como ese de ahí, ese de allá, Hagand allá... este truco, ¿verdad?

"Hagand's here? Never mind—I'll ask him."

[EN] Greetings, friend . I hope my invisibility potion served you well.

Did I overhear you discussing flowers with this goblin smuggler? I keep a considerable number of local flowers on hand for my alchemy. I most likely have what you need, and you are more than welcome to them."Thank you."
[ES] Saludos, amigo . Espero que mi poción de invisibilidad te haya servido bien.

¿Te he oído por casualidad discutiendo sobre flores con este contrabandista goblin? Tengo una cantidad considerable de flores locales a mano para mi alquimia. Lo más probable es que tenga lo que necesitas, y son totalmente tuyas."Thank you."

[EN] My pleasure. But I actually came to speak to you about the Relativity Stones.

Knowing that Garm has failed multiple times to recharge the Relativity Stone, I kept one, to experiment with under the same conditions as our ancestors did when they first created the teleportal.

And I failed—but unlike Garm, I was easily able to discern why I failed, and why Garm has failed, as well."Okay...what did you find out?"
[ES] Un placer. Pero en realidad vine a hablar contigo sobre las Relativity Stones.

Sabiendo que Garm ha fallado múltiples veces en recargar la Relativity Stone, guardé una para experimentar bajo las mismas condiciones que nuestros antepasados cuando crearon por primera vez el teleportal.

Y fallé, pero a diferencia de Garm, pude discernir fácilmente por qué fallé y por qué Garm también ha fallado."Okay...what did you find out?"

[EN] The only variable is the Storm Barrier. We think of it as a physical barrier, but it is clearly magical as well. That is why the teleportal does not function.

If the Storm Barrier can be disabled somehow, the teleportal will function again. And I believe that since the archdevas are able to pass through it, they must know a way to disable it."Seems logical. How can I help?"
[ES] La única variable es la Storm Barrier. La consideramos una barrera física, pero claramente también es mágica. Es por eso que el teleportal no funciona.

Si de alguna manera se puede desactivar la Storm Barrier, el teleportal volverá a funcionar. Y creo que, dado que los archdevas pueden cruzarla, deben conocer una forma de desactivarla."Seems logical. How can I help?"
